item.title: Phil Upchurch, Legendary Guitarist and Bassist for Michael Jackson and Aretha Franklin, Dies at 84
item.description: Phil Upchurch, the guitarist and bassist heard with Michael Jackson, Aretha Franklin, and George Benson, has died at 84. We reflect on his remarkable legacy.

item.title: Michael League’s Cinematic Groove: Snarky Puppy & Metropole Orkest Perform “As You Are But Not As You Were”
item.description: Snarky Puppy and Metropole Orkest team up again for a dynamic performance, featuring Michael League on Bacci bass and sweeping orchestral textures.

item.title: Flea Breaks Down the Hardest Red Hot Chili Peppers Bass Lines in Rick Beato’s New Interview
item.description: Flea tells Rick Beato which Chili Peppers songs challenge him the most, shares his bass heroes, and offers new insight ahead of his solo album.

item.title: Guns N’ Roses Drop Two New Songs, With Duff McKagan Driving the Low End on “Nothin’” and “Atlas”
item.description: Guns N’ Roses return with two new singles, “Nothin’” and “Atlas,” featuring Duff McKagan’s signature tone. Hear the tracks and see the band’s 2026 tour dates.

item.title: A Live SBL Jam: Janek Gwizdala, Larry Goldings, and Clarence Penn Tackle Michael Jackson
item.description: This SBL session captures Janek Gwizdala Larry Goldings and Clarence Penn creating their own version of a Michael Jackson track as the arrangement develops in the room.

item.title: Bootsy Collins’ First Fender Bass Just Sold — and the Final Bid Shocked Everyone
item.description: Bootsy Collins’ first Fender Jazz Bass, originally bought for him by James Brown, has officially sold at auction. Here’s the wild story behind the historic instrument.

item.title: Tye Trujillo Pushes OTTTO Into a New Era With the "Sweaty Pool" EP
item.description: OTTTO returns with "Sweaty Pool," a new EP marking a fresh era for Tye Trujillo and the band, featuring a collaboration with Nick Oliveri.

item.title: Ernest Tibbs and Simon Phillips Showcase Tight Rhythm Work on “You Can’t But You Can” at Little Big Beat Studio
item.description: Ernest Tibbs and Simon Phillips appear at Little Big Beat for a Studio Live Session performance of You Cant But You Can with Tibbs on his Xotic five string Jazz.

item.title: This Week in Bass: Bootsy’s Historic Fender, Steve Harris’s New Precision, and Flea’s Fiery Solo Track
item.description: Bootsy Collins’ first Fender Jazz hits auction, Steve Harris gets a new Precision model, and Flea unveils a new solo track. Catch up on this week’s bass news.

item.title: Groove Podcast: Billy Sherwood on Carrying Chris Squire’s Torch and Finding His Own Voice in YES
item.description: Groove Podcast: Billy Sherwood reflects on his musical roots, Chris Squire’s influence, and the evolving creative role he now carries in Yes, from the studio to the stage.
